cases.scenario: Unsupported method (TRACE) returns 405 with Allow header
cases.expected: 405 Method Not Allowed includes an Allow header listing supported methods (RFC 9110 S15.5.6)
cases.actual: 405 returned but with no Allow header (results_detail.csv case gJqkGW)

cases.scenario: Non-standard method (QUERY) returns 405 Method Not Allowed
cases.expected: Any method not declared in the OpenAPI spec for an existing path returns 405
cases.actual: 404 returned instead of 405 (results_detail.csv case cbloDm) - falls through to Nest's no-route-matched handler
cases.notes: Express/Nest router-level limitation (QUERY not in its verb table), not specific to this controller; low business impact

cases.scenario: All other Schemathesis checks pass (10 check types / 44 passing instances across 6 cases)
cases.steps: Schemathesis examples + coverage + fuzzing phases against GET /categories (TRACE, QUERY, OPTIONS, GET x3)
cases.expected: No 5xx, auth, timing, header or negative-data failures
cases.actual: All passed: not_a_server_error, status_code_conformance, missing_required_header, allow_header_conformance, object_level_authorization, max_response_time, use_after_free, ensure_resource_availability, positive_data_acceptance, negative_data_rejection, and the passing instances of unsupported_method (OPTIONS + both GET cases) all passed
cases.notes: content_type_conformance / response_headers_conformance / response_schema_conformance excluded here - see ST:schema-conformance:user (vacuous pass, spec has no 200 schema)

cases.scenario: 200 body conforms to a documented response schema
cases.expected: 200 body validated against a documented schema
cases.actual: Checks passed vacuously: openapi.json path /categories GET 200 is "{\"description\":\"\"}" with no content/schema key at all, confirmed against categories.controller.ts (no @ApiOkResponse/DTO on findAll()); 3 real 200s were returned (cases vgyhXb, 4qZnyI, JmF5dg) but nothing could be checked against
cases.notes: Coverage gap #1 in reports\EP-033\summary.md; not filed as a separate bug (no bugs.md entry) - fix is adding @ApiOkResponse({ type: ..., isArray: true }) to CategoriesController.findAll()

cases.scenario: Category tree returned by GET /categories reflects only customer-facing categories (per BA-confirmed taxonomy rules)
cases.preconditions: No fixtures needed (no path/query params); endpoint has no @UseGuards and no APP_GUARD auth guard (categories.controller.ts, categories.module.ts, app.module.ts:104) so it is effectively public for all roles
cases.expected: Per sheet title: only categories intended to be customer-facing per BA-confirmed taxonomy rules should appear
cases.actual: Code review: Category model (prisma\schema.prisma) has no isActive/visible/customerFacing flag; categories.repository.ts findAll() returns every row unfiltered (orderBy sortOrder/name only). The findAllBySlugs() comment explicitly notes 'QA still holds the legacy flat categories (Boots, Shirts & Tops, ...) beside the Women/Men/Kids/Gear tree', confirming non-customer-facing legacy rows exist in the same table findAll() queries with no exclusion. The 2026-11-09 re-run again got a real 200 but did not capture/assert response body content (no schema to check field/slug values against), so it still cannot confirm whether legacy categories are actually present in the live QA response today
cases.notes: Needs either (a) BA's confirmed list of which category slugs/ids are customer-facing vs legacy to diff against the live response body, or (b) the actual QA response body captured for manual inspection. Sheet shows Testing Status = Manually Executed and In Postman = YES, so this may already have been checked in Postman - not available to this run. No audits\EP-033.md exists to cross-reference.
